milestones.name: Kill all three Dreamers
milestones.note: Breaks the seal on the Black Egg entrance

milestones.name: Enter Temple of the Black Egg
milestones.note: Accessible after all three Dreamers are defeated

milestones.name: Acquire World Sense
milestones.note: From the Lore Tablet next to the Bench in the Temple of the Black Egg

milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight rescues Zote from a Vengefly King; must be done before acquiring Mantis Claw or Zote dies

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Knight rescues Zote from spider webs in Deepnest

milestones.name: Defeat Zote at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: Grants the Rivalry achievement; Zote deals no damage

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; unlocks the door inside the Tower of Love

milestones.name: Defeat the Hollow Knight
milestones.note: Boss fight accessible inside the Temple of the Black Egg

milestones.name: Defeat the Radiance
milestones.note: Boss fight accessible inside the Temple of the Black Egg

zones.name: Temple of the Black Egg
zones.fingerprintHint: Located near the entrance to Dirtmouth; contains a black stone egg adorned with three Dreamer masks; has a Lore Tablet and Bench
zones.note: Access blocked by a seal until all three Dreamers are killed

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Area referenced as context for Zote's journey and temple proximity

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.note: Zote appears here after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.note: Zote is found trapped in the mandibles of a Vengefly King here

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Zote found in a corridor leading back to the storerooms

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.note: Zote found stuck in spider webs here

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.note: Zote is found in the resting area and becomes the final boss of the first trial

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location where the Love Key is found

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.note: The Love Key unlocks a door inside here where the Collector can be fought

abilities.name: World Sense
abilities.note: Acquired from the Lore Tablet next to the Bench

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love to fight the Collector
abilities.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love; made of shellwood nail cannot deal damage is a note about Zote not this item

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Referenced as the deadline for saving Zote in Greenpath — if not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies

bosses.name: Hollow Knight
bosses.note: Sealed inside the Black Egg; accessible after all three Dreamers are killed

bosses.name: Radiance
bosses.note: Boss fight accessible inside the Temple of the Black Egg

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to save or abandon Zote

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage; defeating him grants the Rivalry achievement

bosses.name: Collector
bosses.note: Fought behind the door unlocked by the Love Key
